This district frames the whole subject: what it means for a program to learn from examples, the kinds of feedback a learner can have, how a dataset is laid out, why data must be split before judging a model, and the loop that actually changes a model's numbers. Everything later in machine learning is a variation on these five ideas.

Topics on this stretch of the road:

  • What Is Machine Learning: data, a model family, a loss and an optimiser.
  • Kinds of Learning: supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement.
  • Datasets, Features and Labels: rows, columns, targets and leakage.
  • Train, Validation and Test Sets: honest measurement on unseen data.
  • The Learning Loop: predict, measure, nudge, repeat.
